_comment: Dry-run of `apr publish` against the actual SHIP-TWO-001 teacher directory
with the canonical cuda+xet release binary. Proves all three teacher
artifacts route to the Xet CAS path (not HTTP LFS, not reject_oversized_file).
Does NOT perform a network upload — no HF_TOKEN required.
what_this_proves: All three teacher artifacts exceed the 5 GiB HTTP LFS threshold and route to Xet
The dispatch gate in upload_via_lfs correctly calls should_use_xet(size)
The canonical binary has the Xet feature linked in (not the FAIL-fallback message)
The sizes reported by the CLI match the contract-recorded sizes to the byte
what_this_does_not_prove: Whether the live Xet CAS + LFS pointer commit will succeed (FALSIFY-PUB-LFS-010)
Whether the xet-core chunking/dedup/xorb phases are correct (delegated to hf-xet 1.5.1 reference impl)
Whether sha256 round-trip matches after upload (PM-002 post-upload gate)

next_action.expected_output: 3x Xet CAS uploads + 3x LFS pointer commits, evidence written to evidence/ship-two-001/ex-04-xet-upload.{log,json}
